en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Aban Bin Usman, from Abu Al Abbas, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘They came to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> with a short, ugly man who had illness in his belly, and the veins of his belly had turned around. He had been immoral with a woman, so she said, ‘I did not know of him except that he entered into me’. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said to him: ‘Did you commit adultery?’ So he said, ‘Yes’, and he was not married. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> raised his<sup>saww</sup> gaze and lowered it. Then he<sup>saww</sup> called for a palm branch, counted a hundred, then whipped him with its stalk’.
